## 行程

### 上午: 品川直達鎌倉
* 交通: 6:50 [從品川站搭乘 JR 橫須賀線直達鎌倉站](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Shinagawa+Prince+Hotel,+4+Chome-10-30+Takanawa,+Minato+City,+Tokyo+108-8611,+Japan/Kamakura+Station,+1+Chome-15+Onarimachi,+Kamakura,+Kanagawa+248-0012,+Japan/@35.4740973,139.6346195,11z/am=t/data=!4m18!4m17!1m5!1m1!1s0x60188a5760190fa7:0x762af933935909b0!2m2!1d139.7366216!2d35.627534!1m5!1m1!1s0x601845c22a4f73df:0xc7e93a3e84fb0e0e!2m2!1d139.5506805!2d35.3190125!2m3!6e1!7e2!8j1788163200!3e3?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)（約 1hr，免換車）
* 08:00 到[鎌倉站](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kamakura+Station/@35.3190125,139.5506805,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x601845c22a4f73df:0xc7e93a3e84fb0e0e!8m2!3d35.3190125!4d139.5506805!16s%2Fg%2F1tfzb46k?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
* **搭江之電 Enoden Line (鐮倉 $\leftrightarrow$ 長谷 $\leftrightarrow$ 鎌倉高校前 $\leftrightarrow$ 江之島)**

### 鎌倉 & 江之島精華景點
* 北鎌倉 / [鶴岡八幡宮](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Tsurugaoka+Hachiman-gu/@35.3358115,139.5502049,15z/data=!3m1!5s0x601845b87972ba87:0x226ac39ed1633d99!4m6!3m5!1s0x601845b87890aa89:0xa867ad10105036b5!8m2!3d35.3259856!4d139.5563462!16zL20vMDVtZjhx?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) / [小町通](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Komachi+St,+Kamakura,+Kanagawa,+Japan/@35.3222668,139.5526999,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x601845c3adf316fb:0x3fd2da075f503fd8!8m2!3d35.3222668!4d139.5526999!16s%2Fg%2F11fkssrpp1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
  * 感受古都歷史氛圍與特色小吃。
* [長谷寺](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Hase-dera/@35.3124791,139.5331106,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x601845f4077127d5:0x57eb6150baf7add1!8m2!3d35.3124791!4d139.5331106!16zL20vMDg1OXFw?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) & [鎌倉大佛](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kotoku-in/@35.3168145,139.5357442,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x601845f2df49bc05:0x1ec393b02d6bef4c!8m2!3d35.3168145!4d139.5357442!16s%2Fg%2F11c2pcz953?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
  * 參觀高德院大佛與長谷寺海景。
* [鎌倉高校前](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Kamakurakōkō-Mae+Station/@35.3067242,139.5005569,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x60184f16e67c1621:0x1941385abcdafc7d!8m2!3d35.3067242!4d139.5005569!16s%2Fm%2F02vnkjw?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
  * 灌籃高手平交道景點與湘南海岸風光。
* [江之島](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Enoshima,+Fujisawa,+Kanagawa+251-0036,+Japan/@35.3011466,139.4809934,15z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x60184ee6a0890aa5:0x4fe5988514a5aec!8m2!3d35.2990992!4d139.4809269!16zL20vMDF0MGNx?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D): 
  * 老街散步
  * [江島神社](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Enoshima+Shrine+Hetsumiya/@35.3003785,139.477771,17z/data=!4m7!3m6!1s0x60184ee42ebf95c5:0xfa7d72e70c9a705f!8m2!3d35.3003664!4d139.4795955!15sCgzmsZ_ls7bnpZ7npL5aDyIN5rGf5bO2IOelnuekvpIBDXNoaW50b19zaHJpbmWaASNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndjbGxwVFVOM0VBReABAPoBBAgdECQ!16s%2Fm%2F0vxdgy4?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=eb3c567b-4a5c-48c0-8a38-8f7f17fa295a)看夕陽落日。

### 晚上: 返抵品川
* 從江之島/藤澤搭乘 JR 橫須賀線/東海道線直達品川站。 (10點前回去)
